title: Warm Syrian Lamb Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting Syrian dish featuring jasmine rice, caramelized onions, and tender lamb, all cooked to perfection in a large tagliere vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagliere vessel over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the lamb pieces to the vessel and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Add the jasmine rice to the vessel and stir to combine with the lamb and onions.
Add 4 cups of water to the vessel and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the vessel, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the vessel from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes before serving.
